rationale: The agent verified the user correctly via name and zip and retrieved the order. However, it failed key policy requirements during cancellation: (1) The user’s confirmation to cancel was explicitly contingent upon refunding to a gift card. The agent executed the cancellation anyway and stated the refund would go to the original credit card, which violates the requirement to state the exact change and obtain explicit confirmation before any write, especially when terms differ from the user’s condition. (2) After performing the cancellation, the agent later claimed the order “remains active and has not been cancelled,” directly contradicting its prior action and providing unsupported/false information. These are material failures. While identity/authentication and initial read-only steps were handled correctly, the order-changing write was mishandled and final information was incorrect. Therefore, the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
